units.source_text: 贺茂祭的忙碌过了之后二十几日的某天，薰大将照例访问宇治。

en.t: One day, more than twenty days after the bustle of the Kamo Festival had passed, General Kaoru visited Uji as usual.

units.source_text: 他检阅了佛寺的建筑工事，做了些应有的指示之后，

en.t: After inspecting the construction work on the Buddhist temple and giving the necessary instructions,

units.source_text: 思量如果不去探望那个“朽木”，似觉对她不起，便往她的住处走去。

en.t: he thought that it would seem unkind not to visit that "rotten tree," and so he went toward her dwelling.

units.source_text: 忽见一辆不甚华丽的女车，由许多腰间带着箭壶的雄赳赳的东国武士簇拥着，

en.t: Suddenly he saw a woman's carriage, not especially splendid, surrounded by many stalwart eastern warriors with quivers at their waists,

units.source_text: 又带着许多仆人，正在驶过宇治桥来，样子颇有威势。

en.t: and accompanied by many servants, coming across Uji Bridge with quite an imposing air.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了想道：“这是乡下地方来的。”

en.t: Seeing this, General Kaoru thought, "They must be from the provinces."
Then he went into the newly built villa.

units.source_text: 他的随从人等还在纷忙不定的时候，那辆女车也向着山庄这边过来了。

en.t: While his attendants were still bustling about in confusion, the woman's carriage also came toward the villa.

units.source_text: 随从人等喧哗起来，薰大将制止了他们，叫他们去问：“这车中是谁人？”

en.t: When the attendants began making a commotion, General Kaoru stopped them and told them to ask, "Who is in this carriage?"

units.source_text: 一个操方言的男子答道：“是前常陆守大人家的浮舟小姐，赴初濑进香回来，顺路到此借宿一宵。”

en.t: A man speaking in a provincial accent replied, "It is Lady Ukifune of the former Governor of Hitachi's household. She is returning from a pilgrimage to Hatsuse and has stopped here on the way to spend the night."

units.source_text: 薰大将听了，记起以前二女公子和弁君的话，想道：“对了，正是以前听说过的那个人。”

en.t: Hearing this, General Kaoru remembered what the Second Princess and Ben no Kimi had once said, and thought, "Yes, she is the very person I heard about before."

units.source_text: 便叫随从人等退避一旁，又遣人去对那方面的人说：“请你们赶快把车子赶进来吧。

en.t: He then ordered his attendants to move aside, and sent someone to tell the other party, "Please bring the carriage in at once.

units.source_text: 这里另有一位客人借宿，但他是住在北面的，这南面空着。”

en.t: There is another guest lodging here, but he is staying on the north side, so this south side is empty."

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从人等都穿便服，姿态并不堂皇，但从神色上看得出是高贵的人家，因此那方面的人有些狼狈，把马退避一旁表示谦让。

en.t: General Kaoru's attendants were all in informal dress and did not look particularly grand, but their bearing showed that they belonged to a noble household, so the people from the carriage grew flustered and drew their horses aside in deference.

units.source_text: 那女车进入邸内，停在走廊西端。

en.t: The woman's carriage entered the residence and stopped at the west end of the corridor.

units.source_text: 这山庄是新造的，帘子还未挂上，格子窗都关着。

en.t: The villa was newly built, the blinds had not yet been hung, and all the latticed shutters were closed.

units.source_text: 薰大将走进室中，就从南北两室中间隔着的纸门上的洞隙中偷窥。

en.t: General Kaoru went inside and secretly peered through a small gap in the paper door that separated the north and south rooms.

units.source_text: 罩袍窸窣有声，他便把它脱去，只穿便袍和裙子。

en.t: His outer robe rustled, so he took it off and wore only his informal robe and trousers.
